sub: Messages farmers send from the Jutyar app: questions, reports, complaints and requests. Your reply reaches the farmer in the app.
search: Search the text, a farmer's name or phone
empty_text: When a farmer sends a message from the app, it shows here.
pick_text: Choose a message from the list to read it and reply.
reply_ph: Hello, thank you for your message.
reply_note: The farmer sees your reply in the app. A new reply replaces the earlier one.
read_only: Your role can read messages but not reply.
del_text: The message and its photos are removed for good.
